svg.title: Augustus CRM AI meeting scheduler
svg.desc: Transparent glass-style football CRM dashboard where an AI agent schedules a meeting with a sporting director through chat.

g.text: I reviewed both calendars and the current recruitment brief.
Brighton has one matching slot before Friday.
I found an open slot with Brighton’s Sporting Director.
Would you like me to propose tomorrow at 10:30 AM?
Yes, schedule it and include the winger shortlist.
Done. The invitation is confirmed and both parties
received the agenda and player shortlist.
Review winger shortlist and role fit
